plan.title: Annual Donation Summary
plan.subtitle: Key insights into donation trends and patterns this year.

panels.title: Total Donations
panels.sql: SELECT SUM(Amount) AS total_donations FROM donor_transactions WHERE strftime('%Y', Date) = strftime('%Y', 'now')

panels.title: Donations by Mode
panels.sql: SELECT Mode, SUM(Amount) AS total_amount FROM donor_transactions WHERE strftime('%Y', Date) = strftime('%Y', 'now') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 20

panels.title: Monthly Donation Trend
panels.sql: SELECT strftime('%m', Date) AS month, SUM(Amount) AS monthly_total FROM donor_transactions WHERE strftime('%Y', Date) = strftime('%Y', 'now') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Top 10 Donors
panels.sql: SELECT Donor, SUM(Amount) AS total_donated FROM donor_transactions WHERE strftime('%Y', Date) = strftime('%Y', 'now') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10

panels.title: Donations by City
panels.sql: SELECT City, SUM(Amount) AS city_total FROM donor_transactions WHERE strftime('%Y', Date) = strftime('%Y', 'now') GROUP BY 1

plan.narrative: This year, we received a total of {{p1}} in donations. The most common donation method was {{p2.Mode}}, accounting for a significant portion of the total.  Monthly donations showed a trend, with the highest amount received in {{p3.month}} ({{p3.monthly_total}}). Our top 10 donors collectively contributed {{p4.total_donated}}.  Donations were spread across various cities, with {{p5.City}} being a key contributor.
